A '''Rendili StarDrive Y-wing''' was operated by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] during the early days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While on a mission to save ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Triclops]] from a mind-controlling device imbedded in his skull, Luke Skywalker flew this Y-wing with a crew consisting of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Prince]] [[Ken]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arzid]]. After landing the Y-wing within the mushroom forests of Arzid, the crew searched the planet for [[Macaab mushroom|Macaab Mushrooms]], a fungus detrimental to the removal of Triclops' implant. When Luke and Ken were abducted by agents of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], Chewbacca took over as the Y-wing's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and alerted the New Republic of Luke and Ken's capture.<ref name="POTDS" />
